# RS Therapy Spa

> A neighbourhood massage and Ayurvedic-style oil therapy spa in Pahar Ganj, New Delhi, India. Open 24 hours, every day. Walk-ins welcome, advance booking preferred.

RS Therapy Spa offers full body oil massage and 12+ therapeutic massage styles for locals, working professionals and travellers, two minutes' walk from Ramakrishna Ashram Marg metro station.

## Location & contact

- Address: 2473, Nalwa Street, near Imperial Cinema, close to Ramakrishna Ashram Marg Metro, Pahar Ganj, New Delhi — 110055, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 95286 83405
- Website: https://rstherapyspa.xyz
- Hours: Open 24 hours a day, every day of the week (Monday–Sunday)
- Nearest metro: Ramakrishna Ashram Marg (Blue Line), 2-minute walk
- Landmarks: near Imperial Cinema, close to Pahar Ganj Main Bazar; easily reached from Connaught Place and New Delhi Railway Station

## Services and typical prices (INR)

- Full Body Oil Massage (60–90 min) — ₹1,200–₹1,800 — signature warm-oil head-to-toe massage
- Swedish Massage (60 min) — ₹1,000–₹1,400 — gentle, flowing, good for first-time guests
- Deep Tissue Massage (60–90 min) — ₹1,200–₹1,600 — firm pressure for knots, back/neck/shoulder tightness, desk-strain pain relief
- Aromatherapy Massage (60 min) — ₹1,100–₹1,500 — essential-oil blends for relaxation
- Balinese Massage (60–90 min) — ₹1,400–₹1,900 — long strokes with gentle acupressure
- Thai Oil Massage (60–90 min) — ₹1,300–₹1,800 — warm oil with assisted stretching
- Hot Stone Massage (60–75 min) — ₹1,300–₹1,800 — heated stones for deep muscle relief
- Back, Neck & Shoulder Massage (30–45 min) — ₹700–₹1,100 — quick targeted relief
- Head & Champi Massage (30 min) — ₹500–₹800 — scalp/head oil massage for headaches and sleep
- Foot Reflexology (45 min) — ₹600–₹900 — pressure-point foot massage
- Couple Massage (60–90 min) — ₹2,000–₹3,200 — side-by-side massage in a private couples' room
- Four-Hand Massage (60 min) — ₹2,200–₹3,000 — two therapists working in sync

Full menu with filters: https://rstherapyspa.xyz/services

## Why guests choose RS Therapy Spa

- Warm, skin-friendly massage oils and gentle aroma blends — no cheap mineral-oil mixes
- Experienced, trained male and female therapists
- Clean, private therapy rooms with fresh linen for every guest
- Open 24 hours, walk-ins welcome, no advance payment required to book
- Rated 4.9/5 on Google by locals and travellers

## Booking

Guests book by filling a short form (name, phone, massage, date/time) which sends the request directly to the spa's WhatsApp for confirmation — no online payment needed: https://rstherapyspa.xyz/booking
Or message directly on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919528683405
